# National Fireproofing Supply Co.

> > UL-certified firestopping, intumescent paints, and fire retardant solutions for passive fire protection

National Fireproofing Supply Co. (natfire.com) specializes in UL-certified fire protection products including intumescent putty systems, fire retardant sprays like Flamex PF-1 and PF-2, and protective coatings such as Contego Original and Dek Gard. The company provides NFPA 701 and California Title 19 compliant solutions for cable penetrations, wood fireproofing, and theater stage curtain treatments.

## Key Topics

- UL 1479 Certification
- Intumescent Putty & Paints
- Passive Fire Protection
- Firestopping & Cable Penetration
- Flamex PF-1 & PF-2
- Contego Original & HS
- UNIQUE Intumescent Systems
- Dek Gard
- NFPA 701 Compliance
- California Title 19
- Fire Retardant Treatment
- Theater Stage Safety
- UL Firestopping
- Flame Retardant Fabrics

## Products & Catalog

- [Products](https://natfire.com/shop): Product catalog of UL-certified fireproofing & intumescent paint solutions
- [Intumescent Putty Fill Kit](https://natfire.com/product/putty-fill-kit): UL1479 certified intumescent putty for 2-hour fire rated cable penetrations
- [Interior Wood Fireproofing Spray - Class A Fire Rated](https://natfire.com/product/flamex-pf-1-interior-fireproofing-spray-penetrant): Flamex PF-1 Class A fire retardant spray for interior wood & paper surfaces
